Hi Lauren,

Thanks for agreeing to help with SignalWave's SIG intake. Attached is the SIG v2.1 questionnaire we use for vendor assessments. We're starting the evidence collection window for our procurement review and need section-level ownership identified so we can route requests efficiently.

Quick asks:
- Please confirm a primary owner for each SIG section (control family) and a backup.
- Where applicable, provide links to evidence (Drive/Confluence) or expected dates when artifacts will be available.
- Can you confirm whether any sections require IT/network diagrams or third-party attestations?

Target timeline: we'd like owners identified by May 14 and initial evidence pointers by May 21 to keep the procurement review on track. If you need a short kick-off call, happy to schedule.

Attachments: SIG-2.1-questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx, 1.3 MB)

Thanks,

Two quick asks:
1) Can each owner drop a one-line evidence pointer in this thread (Drive link or file name + expected availability date) by EOD May 6 so we know which items we still need to chase?
2) If possible, would you be available for a 20-minute follow-up check-in on Friday May 7 at 10:00 PT to review blockers?

If you can't do Friday, propose a time next week. We'll only keep SignalWave reviewers on the call and limit the agenda to 'evidence gating' so we can stay tight to procurement deadlines.
